item.title: "Stretch targets" for mental health a significant step in the right direction
item.description: Alex Stewart responds to confirmation of “stretch targets” for mental health services.

item.title: Survey racism findings "deeply disturbing"
item.description: Matthew Hopkins responds to survey findings from the Society of Radiographers highlighting incidents of racism.

item.title: New explainer shines spotlight on voluntary sector's vital role in Wales' health and care system
item.description: The Welsh NHS Confederation and WCVA publish a joint explainer examining the importance of the voluntary sector’s role in health and care in Wales.

item.title: Esboniad newydd yn taflu goleuni ar rôl hanfodol y sector gwirfoddol yn system iechyd a gofal Cymru
item.description: Conffederasiwn GIG Cymru a CGGC yn cyhoeddi esboniad ar y cyd sy'n archwilio pwysigrwydd rôl y sector gwirfoddol mewn iechyd a gofal yng Nghymru.

item.title: The NHS Alliance response to latest GP data
item.description: Ruth Rankine responds to data from NHS England showing a significant rise in GP appointments.

item.title: The NHS Alliance responds to the Nuffield Trust's findings on corridor care
item.description: Matthew Hopkins responds to an analysis on corridor care by the Nuffield Trust.

item.title: The NHS Alliance response to heat health alerts
item.description: Matthew Hopkins responds to further heat health alerts from the UK Health Security Agency.

item.title: NHS leaders will welcome Prime Minister's commitment on social care
item.description: The NHS Alliance chief executive Sir Ciarán Devane responds to the Prime Minister's comments about a Big Conversation on Care.

item.title: New ICB Network director appointed
item.description: The NHS Alliance has appointed Ralph Coulbeck as its new ICB Network director.

item.title: NHS staff responding to growing pressures as heatwaves impact performance
item.description: The Welsh NHS Confederation responds to the NHS activity and performance statistics for May and June in Wales, which shows sustained pressure on services from prolonged hot weather.

item.title: The NHS Alliance welcomes Yvette Cooper's appointment as secretary of state
item.description: Sir Ciarán Devane welcomes Yvette Cooper's appointment as the new secretary of state for health and social care

item.title: The NHS Alliance responds to the Nuffield Trust’s report on women’s experiences after birth
item.description: Longstanding racial and mental health inequalities affecting women remain, something which is deeply concerning, especially as these disparities continue into motherhood.

item.title: Financial pressures reinforce need for service transformation
item.description: The Welsh NHS Confederation responds to Audit Wales' report on NHS Wales organisations' 2025-26 accounts.

item.title: NHS leaders welcome Welsh Government’s ambitions for prevention agenda
item.description: The Welsh NHS Confederation responds to the Deputy Minister for Public Health and Preventative Health's statement on the Welsh Government's cross-government commitments to prevention.

item.title: NHS leaders working hard as extreme heat strains frontline services
item.description: David Williams responds to latest performance stats and says NHS leaders have been working hard to respond to the growing pressures created by these heatwaves.

item.title: From fast food to flood risk: how planning decisions affect our health and wellbeing
item.description: The Welsh NHS Confederation and Public Health Wales publish an explainer about local planning systems' impact on the population's health and wellbeing.

item.title: The NHS Alliance responds to rollout of new AI tools across the NHS
item.description: Sir Ciarán Devane said it will play a key role in plans to transform the NHS and improve productivity.

item.title: The NHS Alliance responds as consultant doctors vote in favour of strike mandate
item.description: Sir Ciarán Devane says health leaders will be disappointed that senior doctors have voted in favour of potential industrial action.

item.title: Whole-system approach needed to ensure system resilience
item.description: Director of the Welsh NHS Confederation, Darren Hughes, responds to the Cabinet Minister’s statement on health and care winter preparedness 2026/27.

item.title: The NHS Alliance responds to Baroness Amos' maternity report
item.description: Matthew Hopkins says that NHS leaders stand ready to play their part in improving maternity services for women, babies, families and staff
